incidents.name: Etana Custody Funding Unavailable
incidents.message:
Etana as a funding option has been fully discontinued. Please be assured that any funds already received by Kraken are fully available for withdrawal.

Kraken maintains a broad range of trusted banking partners and funding providers to ensure clients can always deposit and withdraw their funds.

For clients who previously used Etana, several alternative funding options are already available, including Customers Bank, Bank Frick, and BCB Group (BLINC Network), with more being introduced shortly. A full list of available options can be found here: https://support.kraken.com/sections/4402838054804-bank-funding-providers
